title: Youth Congress protests PCS recruitment irregularities in Chandigarh

tea.why: Youth Congress members protested against alleged recruitment irregularities in the Punjab Civil Services exam and recent leader arrests.
tea.want: Protesters demanded an investigation into PCS recruitment and the release of jailed Punjab Youth Congress leaders.
tea.changed: Nov 23: Police used water cannons and detained around 110 Youth Congress workers attempting to march to the chief minister's residence.

summary: Members of the Indian Youth Congress and Punjab Youth Congress demonstrated in Chandigarh on November 23, 2026, protesting against alleged recruitment irregularities in the Punjab Civil Services examination and the arrest of state Youth Congress leaders. The demonstration was addressed by Indian Youth Congress national president Uday Bhanu Chib, who accused the state administration of suppressing youth voices. Protesters attempted to march towards the residence of Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. Police used water cannons to stop the march and detained around 110 Youth Congress workers, according to media reports.
demands: Release jailed Punjab Youth Congress leaders
response: Police used water cannons to halt the demonstration and detained around 110 participants as they attempted to march to the chief minister's residence.

arrests.text: around 110 Youth Congress workers were reportedly detained, according to The Times of India

updates.text: Youth Congress members protested over PCS recruitment irregularities in Chandigarh; police deployed water cannons and detained around 110 workers.
